document:0:466:0.text:
Merlin, head of the Arcane Council, legendary mage, and visiting professor of the Serene Lyceum.
By: Alberon von Naclus
document:0:466:0.source_cn:
魔法师协会首席，大魔法师，莱希拉姆特聘教师——梅林。
作者：艾尔波·冯·纳古斯

say:2:1610507501:0.text: Wow! This must be the largest portrait in the gallery!
say:2:1610507501:0.source_cn: 哇哦，这是整个长廊里最大的一幅画像了吧！

say:3:1610507502:0.source_cn: 上面画的是那位传奇的大魔法师梅林吗？

say:6:1610507504:0.text: This is said to be the only portrait that shows Magister Merlin's true face, painted by the famed Alberon von Naclus. Its value is beyond measure, both historically and artistically.
say:6:1610507504:0.source_cn: 据说这是梅林大人唯一一副露出真容的肖像画，又是由著名肖...
say:6:1610507504:0.male: This is said to be the only portrait that shows Magister Merlin's true face, painted by the famed Alberon von Naclus. Its value is beyond measure, both historically and artistically.
say:6:1610507504:0.female: This is said to be the only portrait that shows Magister Merlin's true face, painted by the famed Alberon von Naclus. Its value is beyond measure, both historically and artistically.

say:7:1610507505:0.text: Incredible! So this is what Magister Merlin really looked like... I need to take a closer look!
say:7:1610507505:0.source_cn: 这么珍贵啊！梅林的相貌真的是这个样子吗？唔，我得仔细看看！
